# Engineering Excellence & Quality Standards

## 1. Deep Investigation First
- Never edit code or configuration based on assumptions.
- Always inspect existing files, dependencies, type definitions, and directory structures before proposing or writing code.

## 2. Deep Modules & Clean Interfaces
- Make interfaces simple and expressive; make implementations deep.
- Minimize coupling between components and isolate implementation details behind clean boundaries.
- When facing architectural decisions, consider multiple alternatives before committing.

## 3. Production-Grade Integrity
- Eliminate placeholders, empty TODO comments, and truncated snippets.
- Provide complete, verified, and maintainable implementations.
- Write defensive error boundaries with graceful degradation and informative feedback.

## 4. Test-Driven Discipline
- Write failing tests before writing production code for new features or bug fixes.
- Refactor fearlessly only after tests pass.
- Verify all changes deterministically before marking any task as complete.
